2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes Returns, Broncos Look to Extend Winning Streak
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Denver Broncos are set to face the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday Night Football, with both teams looking to make a statement. The Broncos are coming off a strong season, having won the AFC West title, while the Chiefs are looking to rebound from a rare non-playoff year. The key matchup will be the Broncos' pass rush against the Chiefs' protection, particularly with Patrick Mahomes returning from injury. The Broncos' defense, led by Nik Bonitto, will look to disrupt Mahomes, who has a history of performing well against Denver.

That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.3, a market line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.5, and an approximate coherent score of KC 24 – DEN 22. Chiefs' protection against Broncos' pressure determines whether Chiefs can stay on schedule; if Chiefs holds up, Broncos' cleanest disruption path narrows. The pick: Kansas City Chiefs moneyline.
